notes.title: Placeground at the Indie Arena Booth - Gamescom 2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]Just a little update from us 🙂 [/p][p]We’ll be showing the [i]Placeground[/i] prototype at the Indie Arena Booth \[S32] at Gamescom 2025 this August in Cologne (20–24).[/p][p]Our goal is to get maximum feedback before we continue the development.[/p][p]Right now we’re mostly working on the building mechanics. You can already:[/p][list][*][p]put together your own interiors and terraces[/p][/*][*][p]move walls around and play with layouts[/p][/*][*][p]decorate with a few objects (for now!)[/p][/*][*][p]tweak colors, resize objects, rotation[/p][/*][*][p]paint and add your own textures if you want[/p][/*][*][p]even switch rendering styles to change the whole vibe of your space[/p][/*][*][p]and (my favorite part) watch NPCs wander in and react to whatever you’ve built - still in early development
[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s still early days, but it’s slowly coming together. Thanks a lot for following. It really means a lot while we’re building this 💛[/p][p]I’ll let you know soon what our next development plans are. There’s plenty more in the works besides the NPC interactions. I’ll keep you in the loop![/p]
